title: Additional Cast for 'Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru?' Announced

title: Perfect Addiction 'Light Anime' Unveils Main Cast & Staff, July Debut
content: The official website for the "light anime" adaptation of Kaoruko Miyama 's Perfect Addiction boys-love manga opened on Wednesday and unveiled the anime's key visual, main cast and staff members, and July premiere on the tvk channel.

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Reveals Episode 7 Preview Trailer and Image
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has revealed the Episode 7 (Episode 73 overall) preview ahead of its May 20, 2026 premiere. Season 4 began on April 8 and ranked first in the first three of our weekly polls of the season , as well as the sixth one . Studio WHITE FOX is animating.

title: Manga 'Omae, Tanuki ni Naranee ka?' Receives TV Anime Adaptation
content: Production company Happinet opened an official website for a television anime adaptation of Tomo Nagawa 's Omae, Tanuki ni Naranee ka? ( Would You like to Be a Tanuki? ) manga, revealing the main staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video on Wednesday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Tomo Nagawa's 'Would you like to be a tanuki?' Manga Gets TV Anime
content: Japanese publisher Ichjinsha announced on Wednesday that Tomo Nagawa 's Would you like to be a tanuki? ( Omae, Tanuki ni Narane--ka? ) manga is inspiring a television anime. The staff unveiled a teaser video and visual for the anime. Nagawa also drew the below illustration to celebrate the anime's announcement.
author: ANN

title: Home Made Kazoku Hip Hop Group to Return After 10-Year Hiatus
content: Japanese hip-hop group Home Made Kazoku announced on their official website on Tuesday that the group will return to making music. The announcement noted that the group remains under their old label Ki/oon Music , under Sony Music Labels . The group went on a hiatus after "The Last Live" concert on December 29, 2016.
author: ANN
